chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The best of you are those who speak well, feed food, and pray at night while people are sleeping.'
ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics that make a person among the best of believers according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, synthesizes the spiritual and social dimensions of excellence by linking refined speech (husn al-kalam) and generosity with the devotion of night prayer (Qiyam al-Layl). In Shia tradition, this triad illustrates how inner piety manifests through ethical interaction with others and sustained worship during the quiet hours, reflecting the comprehensive nature of the ideal believer.
